mapper.select: SELECT r.equipment_id AS "equipmentId", r.report_date AS "reportDate", SUM(r.good_qty) AS "goodQty", SUM(r.scrap_qty) AS "scrapQty", SUM((r.good_qty + r.scrap_qty) * op.std_hours) AS "idealHours" FROM mes_report r JOIN mes_wo_op op ON op.id = r.op_id WHERE r.equipment_id IS NOT NULL AND r.report_date >= #{begin} AND r.report_date <= #{end} AND r.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} GROUP BY r.equipment_id, r.report_date
